These are the upstream runtime notices for the pinned Bun 1.4.3 compiler used
to build UR's standalone executable. The executable embeds this runtime.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v1.4.3/LICENSE.md

`LICENSE.md` includes the runtime component licenses and the source/relinking
instructions supplied by Bun. The native build checks the compiler version so
these notices match the runtime it embeds.
